description: This is a PHP test class for the BuzzLikeDao within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods related to liking and unliking shares and comments, as well as retrieving like entities and counts, within the Buzz module. It uses PHPUnit for testing and mocks certain services such as DateTimeHelperService.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the BuzzLikeDao's functionalities related to liking, unliking, and retrieving likes on shares and comments in the Buzz module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, including mocking services and populating test data.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnShare entity and verifies the persisted data.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnComment entity and verifies the persisted data.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests deletion of BuzzLikeOnShare by share ID and employee ID, and verifies removal from repository.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests deletion of BuzzLikeOnComment by comment ID and employee ID, and verifies removal.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a BuzzLikeOnShare by share ID and employee number.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a BuzzLikeOnComment by comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of likes on shares based on share ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities based on comment ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of likes on comments based on comment ID.
